plain.li: [trait:Industrious] I'll sleep when the walls are finished.
Half the jobs on the list have been waiting since last season. Let's clear them.
[fall] Winter's coming whether we're rested or not.
[trait:Industrious|trait:HardWorker] I was working late anyway, and now there's company at the bench.

warm.li: I'll keep a pot warm for whoever finishes last. It'll probably be me.

blunt.li: Some of you have been taking it easy since the day you got here.
[trait:Industrious] Finally, I'm not the only one sweating.

cheerful.li: Long days mean a lot crossed off the list! I've already written it out.
[highmood] I feel like I could dig through a mountain today!

gloomy.li: The work never ends anyway, and now it's official.

cold.li: Idle hands were costing us, and now they won't.
They'll be tired for a week, and the walls will be up.

plain.li: [trait:Lazy|trait:Slothful] I had plans for this evening, and all of them involved my bed.
I'll be asleep on my feet by the second evening.
[night] It's past dark and I'm still hauling stone by feel.
[old] My knees gave up on long days years ago.

warm.li: [hurt] I'll work, but slowly. My stitches pull every time I bend.
I can keep up, but watch the young ones; they won't say when they're done in.

blunt.li: Work me any longer and you'll get crooked walls.
[trait:Slothful] I've thought about it at length, lying down, and the answer is no.

cheerful.li: I've spent so long with this shovel I've given it a name!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] I was tired before this started, and now I can barely lift my arms.

cold.li: Tired workers make mistakes, and mistakes cost more than the extra hours buy.

plain.li: I've counted the stores twice. Smaller bowls now, or empty ones later.
[winter] Count the shelves, then count the days to spring. Then complain about the bowls.
[trait:Ascetic] Half a bowl is plenty. The other half was only ever habit.
[poor] There's no silver left to buy food with, so we stretch what we have.

warm.li: If we all take less now, the stores will last until the next harvest.
I'll serve it on the small plates so it looks like more. It's an old trick.

blunt.li: Stop whining about the bowls; you'd like starving even less.

cheerful.li: [trait:Ascetic] Light meals suit me! I've never felt so clear-headed.

gloomy.li: Eat less now, so there's something left to serve at the funerals.

cold.li: Hunger is uncomfortable; starvation is a staffing problem.

plain.li: [trait:Gourmand] I dreamed about a proper roast last night and woke up starving.
My belt's on its last hole, and my bowl's on its last spoonful.
[winter] It's freezing, and they've cut the one thing keeping me warm.
I'm hauling stone on a breakfast you could fit in a pocket.

warm.li: I'll eat less, but give the people on the heavy jobs some extra.

blunt.li: [trait:Gourmand] Touch my bowl again and I'll eat the hand.
[trait:Greedy] I earned a full bowl. Somebody's going to owe me the other half.

cheerful.li: I chew every bite twenty times now! It makes the bowl last.

gloomy.li: Smaller bowls today, kibble with the animals next. I can see where this goes.
[lowmood] Smaller meals, and nothing to look forward to at the end of the day.

cold.li: Hungry workers are slow workers. You've saved food and spent labor.
[trait:Greedy] Ration the newcomers. Some of us have been here longer.

plain.li: [afterraid] We're still digging graves from the last raid. Let's make sure the next ones are theirs.
[trait:Tough] I've been hit by worse than any of you. Line up.
When the raiders come, your hands will know what to do even if the rest of you is scared.
[trait:Brawler,!lowtech] Guns are fine, but fists never jam and never run out.

warm.li: I'd rather everyone sweat out here than bleed out there.
I'll partner with the nervous ones and go slow.

blunt.li: [trait:Bloodlust] Pair me with whoever talks the most. They'll talk less after.
Somebody's going to cry at drill, and that's fine. Better here than at the wall.

cheerful.li: I made up a marching song for drill! It's mostly about stabbing.
[trait:Bloodlust] Real swinging and real shouting! I only wish the blood was real.

gloomy.li: We're all dying out here regardless, so we might as well die with decent aim.

cold.li: Most of us couldn't hit a raider at twenty paces. That has to change.
[afterraid] Half of us froze during the last raid. Correct that.

plain.li: [trait:Wimp] I got a splinter from the practice dummy and had to sit down.
[skill:Plants] The fields are going wild while I'm out here stabbing straw.
My arms are too sore to lift a spoon, never mind a weapon.
[hurt] I'm still healing from the last real fight. Now I'm supposed to have a pretend one?

warm.li: [trait:Kind] I keep pulling my swings. I don't want to hurt anyone, even with a practice blade.
I'll drill, but I won't enjoy swinging at people I eat supper with.

blunt.li: Yell "again" at me once more and you'll see my form up close.
I can already hit things. Usually the right things.

cheerful.li: [trait:Wimp] I've volunteered to carry the bandages, from very far behind!

gloomy.li: Drill all you like. The first real fight will still take somebody's arm off.

cold.li: Tiring everyone out before a raid only helps the raiders.

plain.li: [skill:Intellectual] Finally, an evening where nobody asks me why I'm reading.
Half of us can't tell healroot from a weed. A few evenings would fix that.
[lowtech] I'll teach letters after supper; bring a stick and we'll write in the dirt.
[trait:TooSmart] I've been waiting for this. I have a whole list of things to explain.

warm.li: None of us are stupid. Some of us just never had a quiet evening to learn in.

blunt.li: Sit down and read. Maybe someone will finally stop stacking wood next to the fire.

cheerful.li: [skill:Intellectual] I've made up a quiz! Don't worry, it's mostly easy.
Evening lessons! I'll do funny voices for the boring parts.

gloomy.li: If we're going to die out here, I'd like us to at least understand why.

cold.li: Lessons are cheaper than the mistakes we keep making without them.
[trait:TooSmart] The gap between me and the rest of you is a liability. Let's narrow it.

plain.li: [trait:Brawler] You can't punch a book. I tried during the first lesson.
I read the same page four times and couldn't tell you a word of it.
[evening] I've been working since dawn. I can't take in another word.
The crops don't care whether I can do sums.

warm.li: I'll sit in, but please go easy on the slow readers; I'm one of them.

blunt.li: Teach me something useful, like when lunch is.
[trait:Brawler] Ask me one more question and see what happens.

cheerful.li: I've learned to sleep with my eyes open! I think that counts as a skill.

gloomy.li: [old] I'm too old to learn and too tired to argue, so I'll just sit there.

cold.li: Some people are not worth educating. You're spending the evenings on them anyway.

plain.li: [trait:Ascetic] I've never needed more than a bedroll and a bowl. Nice to have company down here.
We've been asking the council for everything lately. Let's go without for a while.
[rich] We're sitting on a fortune and still whining about chairs. Enough.

warm.li: I'd rather we look after each other than after our furniture.
[trait:Ascetic] It's easier than it sounds. Give it a few days and you'll stop noticing.

blunt.li: You don't need a nicer chair. You need to stop sitting in it.
[trait:Ascetic] Someone asked the council for a statue last week. A statue.

cheerful.li: It'll be like the first weeks again, sleeping on the floor and sharing everything!

gloomy.li: Don't get used to nice things. I never did, and look how well I'm taking this.

cold.li: The more we give people, the more they ask for. This stops that.

plain.li: [trait:Greedy] I had a list, a good one. Now I just have the list.
We bleed for this place, and we can't even ask for a rug.
[trait:Jealous] Funny how austerity started right after some people finished their own rooms.
[rich] There's a room full of silver back there, and I can't ask for a chair.

warm.li: I don't mind for me. I mind for the ones who'd only just started hoping for things.

blunt.li: No wishes, fine. I'll keep my complaints instead. I have plenty.
[trait:Greedy] If nobody's allowed to want anything, I'll want twice as hard in private.

cheerful.li: No new wishes, that's fine, I'll save mine up for later!

gloomy.li: We've lived like this before. We called it the first year.

cold.li: People will put up with this for a while. Then they'll stop putting up with you.

plain.li: [trait:Lazy|trait:Slothful] I was born for this. Specifically for the lying-down part.
Put the tools away. If something catches fire we'll put it out, and that's all the work we do.
[winter] Too cold to work anyway. Might as well be cold together, with music.
[afterraid] We lived through the raid, and that's worth a party.

warm.li: We've all been holding it together for so long, and we need a few days off.
[grieving] I don't feel much like dancing. I'll come anyway; they'd have wanted the music loud.

blunt.li: Anyone I catch working during the festival answers to me.

cheerful.li: I've hidden the good beer! I'll tell you where at sunset.
[highmood] I've been happy all week, and now it's official!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] I'll come. I'll stand near the music and hope some of it gets through.

cold.li: A colony that breaks costs more than a few idle days. Consider this maintenance.

plain.li: [trait:Industrious] All this idling, and the jobs piling up outside.
[poor] We can't afford a party. We can barely afford dinner.
Someone has to watch the walls while the rest of you are drunk, and it'll be me.
[fall] The harvest is standing in the field while we dance around it.

warm.li: Go and have fun. I'll mind the fires.

blunt.li: [trait:Industrious] Party all you want. I'll be in the workshop, being useful.
[afterraid] There's still blood on the floor and you want to dance on it.

cheerful.li: I'll celebrate by finally finishing that shelf!

gloomy.li: The raiders always seem to come when we've let our guard down.

cold.li: Once they've had a festival, they'll expect another. We'll pay for this one later.

plain.li: [skill:Plants] The crops are ready when they're ready, and they're ready now.
[fall] First frost is coming. Anything still in the ground after that is compost.
[poor] We can't buy our way through the winter. We'll have to grow it.
Every row we bring in now is one less night eating raw berries in the dark.

warm.li: I'll show the new ones how to cut without losing a finger. It's easy, mostly.
[skill:Plants] I love this part, all of us out in the rows together.

blunt.li: Pick faster. The blight isn't waiting for you to finish stretching.

cheerful.li: [skill:Plants] I've been waiting all season for this!
[rain] Mud to the ankles! Good for the roots, anyway.

gloomy.li: We'd better hurry. The weather always knows when we're nearly done.

cold.li: A crop still in the field can be lost to frost or blight. Get it into storage.

plain.li: [trait:Undergrounder] The sky's too big out here. I keep waiting for it to fall on me.
[hot] I've been bent double in this heat so long I'm wilting faster than the crops.
I don't know a weed from a crop, and the crops can tell.
[trait:Lazy|trait:Slothful] Plants grow on their own, so why do they need me?

warm.li: I'll do my rows. Could someone bring water out to the far field? People are wilting.

blunt.li: I didn't know surviving out here would involve this much kneeling.
[trait:Undergrounder] Open sky, all day. If I go strange, that's on you.

cheerful.li: I've only cut myself twice today!

gloomy.li: We'll get it all in just in time for the rats to find it.

cold.li: Pulling the miners onto the fields leaves the mountain idle. Poor trade.
[hot|summer] Yield is up, and so is heatstroke; count both.

plain.li: [skill:Construction] I've had that wall in my head since the day I got here, and now I get to build it.
[skill:Mining] There's a vein in the north face I've been eyeing for days. I'm going after it first.
[winter] The cold gets in through every gap, so let's close them.
[trait:Undergrounder] More tunnels, good; the sky has had its chance.
Walls first, then roofs. Everything else can wait.

warm.li: A proper roof over every bed. That's what I'm building toward.

blunt.li: [trait:Industrious] Pick up a hammer or get out of the way.
If it doesn't have a wall around it, it belongs to the raiders.

cheerful.li: [skill:Mining] So much rock to dig! There's bound to be something good in it.

gloomy.li: We build walls, raiders knock them down, and we build them again.

cold.li: Every wall is one fewer direction to defend.

plain.li: [trait:Lazy|trait:Slothful] I carried one block of stone and now I need to lie down.
My hands are so full of splinters I can't hold a spoon.
[night] There's been hammering every night since the walls started going up.
[winter] Laying stone in this cold. We'll lose fingers before we gain rooms.

warm.li: Could we finish the beds before the next wing? People are sleeping in the dust.

blunt.li: Whoever drew up these plans, I'd like a word.
[trait:Slothful] I'll supervise from a chair in the shade.

cheerful.li: I've hit my thumb so many times I've stopped feeling it!

gloomy.li: The next raid will knock a hole in it anyway, usually in the new bit.

cold.li: Building faster means building worse. I've inspected the east wall.

plain.li: [skill:Social] Watch me with the next caravan. They'll leave smiling, with lighter packs.
Our last trade went so badly the muffalo looked embarrassed.
[child] The grown-ups are being polite to each other, and it's weird, and I like it.

warm.li: [trait:Kind] Be gentle with the prisoners. Some of them will be eating at our table soon.
Say good morning to people. You'd be amazed what it fixes.

blunt.li: Fine, if it gets us cheaper medicine I'll be nice to a boomalope.

cheerful.li: [skill:Social] I've been practicing my bow all morning! I've nearly got it.

gloomy.li: Being polite won't save us, but it might get us a better price on a coffin.

cold.li: [trait:Psychopath] I've practiced the smile, and people say it's very convincing now.
Be pleasant to the prisoner until they've joined. After that it's optional.

plain.li: I spent all morning being polite to a prisoner who tried to stab me last week.
[trait:Abrasive] I've bitten my tongue so often it's sore.
[afterraid] Their friends were trying to kill us yesterday, and now I smile at the one in the cell?
I've said thank you so many times the words have stopped meaning anything.

warm.li: I'll try, but I'm not good at finding the right words when I'm tired.

blunt.li: [trait:Abrasive] I said "please" to the trader, and I'm still angry about it.
I don't do nice. Never have.

cheerful.li: I've only called the trader a thief once, and under my breath!

gloomy.li: I can't smile on command; it comes out wrong.

cold.li: Courtesy toward captives is wasted. They remember the cell, not the manners.

plain.li: [grieving] I can't lift anything today, and I'm glad I don't have to.
Leave the tools where they fell; they'll keep.
We never stopped for the last ones, so let's stop for these.

warm.li: I'll cook. Come to the table if you want to, or don't.
[grieving] I can't think straight yet, and a few quiet days is all I want.

blunt.li: Anyone who whistles at the graveside gets a grave of their own.

cheerful.li: I'm going to tell all the funny stories about them! They'd want us laughing.

gloomy.li: [grieving] The grave's finished, and I keep walking out to check it's still there.
We've dug more graves than we've built beds.

cold.li: Grieving workers make errors. A short pause is cheaper than the errors.

plain.li: [trait:Industrious] Sitting still makes it worse, so let me fix a fence, at least.
[afterraid] The raiders don't take days off for our funerals.
[winter] The fires won't feed themselves while we mourn.
[!grieving] I hardly knew them, so let me be quiet somewhere useful.

warm.li: I loved them too, but I'd rather honor them by keeping everyone else alive.

blunt.li: Crying won't weed the fields.

cheerful.li: They'd want the roof fixed, not us moping under it! They hated that leak.

gloomy.li: We stop to grieve, and then there's more to grieve.

cold.li: [trait:Psychopath] I've stood by the grave for the expected length of time. May I go now?
Grief doesn't need all of us, so assign two people to it.

plain.li: [afterraid] They'll be back for whoever they left behind. I'll be waiting.
[night] I'll take the night watch. I like the quiet, and I like seeing them first.
[trait:Bloodlust] I sharpened everything twice. Now I just need someone to try us.
[trait:Tough] Doesn't bother me; I've slept through worse than a shout in the night.

warm.li: Get some sleep; I've got the watch. I'll wake you if anything moves.

blunt.li: Weapon by the bed, boots on. Anyone who grumbles can take first watch.

cheerful.li: Night watch! I've brought snacks to keep us awake.
[trait:Bloodlust] I hope someone tries us tonight!

gloomy.li: They'll come eventually, but at least now we're watching.

cold.li: Raiders pick soft targets, and we're going to stop being one.

plain.li: [trait:Nervous|trait:Volatile] I nearly hit the cook at breakfast when I heard footsteps behind me.
[trait:Wimp] I've gripped my weapon so long my hand's gone numb. Is that an injury?
Sleeping in shifts means I never get a full night.
[night] Every noise out there is a raider or a squirrel, and I can't tell which anymore.

warm.li: Fine, I'll stand watch, but I won't sleep well with a knife by my pillow.

blunt.li: If they come, they come, and me glaring at a tree won't change that.
[trait:Volatile] One more twig snaps and I'm picking a fight with the forest.

cheerful.li: I've only shouted at the wind three times tonight!

gloomy.li: Waiting for the raid is worse than the raid.

cold.li: Tired guards miss things. This makes us feel safer without making us safer.

plain.li: [skill:Medicine] I won't stitch anyone up on a floor a raider bled on.
There's still blood on the hospital floor from the raid before last.
The last time the kitchen looked like this, half of us threw up all night.
[trait:Ascetic] A bare room is easy to clean, as you'll all find out this week.
[hurt] I'd like to heal in a room that doesn't smell like the last patient.

warm.li: A clean bed for everyone who's sick. That's worth a few blisters.

blunt.li: The kitchen's filthier than the prison. Start there.

cheerful.li: [skill:Medicine] I'm going to boil every bandage and blanket we own!

gloomy.li: If something out here has to kill us, it shouldn't be the kitchen.

cold.li: Food poisoning has cost us more work than any raid. Scrub accordingly.

plain.li: [trait:Lazy|trait:Slothful] Dirt was here before us, so show it some respect.
I scrubbed the hospital until my knuckles bled, and now it needs scrubbing again.
[rain] Every pair of muddy boots through that door undoes my morning's work.
[large] With this many people, it's filthy again before the mop's dry.

warm.li: I'll mop, but I don't think the animals understand the new rules.

blunt.li: I'll clean when the boomalopes stop exploding in the yard.
[trait:Slothful] Clean around me; I'm part of the furniture now.

cheerful.li: I scrubbed the dining room twice! It's almost a shame to eat in it.

gloomy.li: We scrub it, someone bleeds on it, we scrub it again.

cold.li: Mopping is low-value work, so give it to the prisoners.
